```{r}
library(ggplot2)
simul_data <- as.data.frame(rnorm(100))
colors <- c('GK', 'MBB')
simul_data$legend <- rep(colors, length.out = 20)
# fake plot just to construct the correct legend
plot_legend <- ggplot(data =simul_data, aes(x=rnorm(100), fill = legend))+
  geom_histogram()+
  theme( legend.direction = "horizontal")+
scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("blue", "lightblue"),
    labels = c( 'GK', 'MBB'),
    drop=FALSE
  ) 
# Légende personnalisée (à ajuster selon vos besoins)
compare_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(plot_legend)
plot_legend
```
This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook. When you execute code within the notebook, the results appear beneath the code. 

Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Ctrl+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}
library(latex2exp)

names <- c('$P_{elec}$', '$Q_{elec}$', "IPI", '$NE Index$')

n <- length(names)
plot_irf_mini_panel_chol <- function(i){
  #i=1
  main_prediction <- lambda_0_log[, i, 1]

  time_horizon <- 1:20
  
  strong_band_inf_GK <-
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_GK[,i,"lower","lambda_01"]
  strong_band_sup_GK <- 
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_GK[,i,"upper","lambda_01"]
  
  strong_band_inf_MBB <-
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_MBB[,i,"lower","lambda_01"]
  strong_band_sup_MBB  <- 
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_MBB[,i,"upper","lambda_01"]
  
  # Plot the responses for each variable
  
  my_plot <- ggplot()+
    
    geom_ribbon(aes(x=time_horizon, ymin = strong_band_inf_GK,
                    ymax = strong_band_sup_GK), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.5) +
    
    geom_ribbon(aes(x=time_horizon, ymin = strong_band_inf_MBB,
                    ymax = strong_band_sup_MBB), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    
    # ggtitle(expression(paste(names[i]))) +
    labs(title = TeX(names[i]),
         x = "Time",
         y = "Unit Points") +
    geom_line(aes(x=time_horizon, y= main_prediction), color = "blue", linetype='dashed')+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
    scale_x_continuous()+
    scale_y_continuous()+
    # Add confidence bands
    theme_minimal()
  return(my_plot)
}


# Apply the function to the sequence 3:10
results <- lapply(c(1:n) , plot_irf_mini_panel_chol)

# Arrange the plots in a grid
plots_grid <- do.call("grid.arrange", c(results, nrow = 2))

final_plot <- plot_grid(plots_grid, compare_legend , ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.1))

title <- ggdraw() + 
  draw_label(TeX('$P_{elec}$ shock IRF'), fontface = 'bold', x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)

# Combine the title and the final plot with legend
final_plot_with_title <- plot_grid(title, final_plot, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1))

# Display the final plot
print(final_plot_with_title)

```

When you save the notebook, an HTML file containing the code and output will be saved alongside it (click the *Preview* button or press *Ctrl+Shift+K* to preview the HTML file).

The preview shows you a rendered HTML copy of the contents of the editor. Consequently, unlike *Knit*, *Preview* does not run any R code chunks. Instead, the output of the chunk when it was last run in the editor is displayed.


```{r}
library(latex2exp)

names <- c('$P_{elec}$', '$Q_{elec}$', "IPI", '$NE Index$')

n <- length(names)
plot_irf_mini_panel_chol <- function(i){
  #i=1
  main_prediction <- lambda_0_log[, i, 2]

  time_horizon <- 1:20
  
  strong_band_inf_GK <-
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_GK[,i,"lower","lambda_02"]
  strong_band_sup_GK <- 
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_GK[,i,"upper","lambda_02"]
  
  strong_band_inf_MBB <-
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_MBB[,i,"lower","lambda_02"]
  strong_band_sup_MBB  <- 
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_MBB[,i,"upper","lambda_02"]
  
  # Plot the responses for each variable
  
  my_plot <- ggplot()+
    
    geom_ribbon(aes(x=time_horizon, ymin = strong_band_inf_GK,
                    ymax = strong_band_sup_GK), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.5) +
    
    geom_ribbon(aes(x=time_horizon, ymin = strong_band_inf_MBB,
                    ymax = strong_band_sup_MBB), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    
    # ggtitle(expression(paste(names[i]))) +
    labs(title = TeX(names[i]),
         x = "Time",
         y = "Unit Points") +
    geom_line(aes(x=time_horizon, y= main_prediction), color = "blue", linetype='dashed')+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
    scale_x_continuous()+
    scale_y_continuous()+
    # Add confidence bands
    theme_minimal()
  return(my_plot)
}


# Apply the function to the sequence 3:10
results <- lapply(c(1:n) , plot_irf_mini_panel_chol)

# Arrange the plots in a grid
plots_grid <- do.call("grid.arrange", c(results, nrow = 2))

final_plot <- plot_grid(plots_grid, compare_legend , ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.1))

title <- ggdraw() + 
  draw_label(TeX('$P_{elec}$ shock IRF'), fontface = 'bold', x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)

# Combine the title and the final plot with legend
final_plot_with_title <- plot_grid(title, final_plot, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1))

# Display the final plot
print(final_plot_with_title)
```
